intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Someone in the Town Square has built a very small stage. A hand-painted sign reads *Royal Comedy Showcase: Participation Voluntary, Embarrassment Inevitable.*

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “I put my name down earlier. Now I’d rather be in the crowd, heckling.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Up front, a wizard pulls a rabbit from a hat.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The rabbit takes one look at the audience and pulls the wizard back inside.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “That rabbit has better instincts than I do.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “The court expects me to be brilliant on command. Like a lamp.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “I don’t want to be a lamp. I don’t want to disappoint everyone, either.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “That’s becoming a dangerous question around you.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Her tail points at the stage, then at the crowd, then at you.

options.labelText: “Go up and I’ll cheer, badly. Stay and we’ll watch terrible jokes together. I’m here either way.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “I think I’d like to stay. Just stay.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: The next comedian announces that his act is entirely improvised.

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: He unrolls a scroll labeled *Entirely Improvised Act* and starts reading.

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Look. Someone even less spontaneous than you.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “And I didn’t even need the stage.”

options.labelText: “You’re brilliant at this. You’ll feel better the second you’re up there.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Maybe. I’d have liked to decide that myself.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She goes up and does ten tidy minutes. The crowd loves it.

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: Coming back down, she thanks everyone. Her smile lasts almost to the bottom step.

options.labelText: “Backing out makes you look weak. A real princess wouldn’t let her public down.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Wonderful. A review, and I didn’t even go on.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She walks off into the crowd and doesn’t look back for you.
